WITH avg_modindex AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
above_average_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.rfistat,
    sa.status_avg,
    am.overall_avg
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN avg_modindex am
  WHERE sa.status_avg > am.overall_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying
  FROM above_average_statuses
)
SELECT 
  aas.rfistat,
  aas.status_avg as avg_modindex,
  aas.status_avg - aas.overall_avg as above_overall_avg,
  aas.status_avg - qm.mean_of_qualifying as diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM above_average_statuses aas
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
ORDER BY aas.status_avg DESC

assumptions.assumption: "above-average" means each RFI status's average modindex is strictly greater than the overall average modindex (not equal to).

alternatives.interpretation: Qualify RFI statuses that have at least one signal with modindex > overall average, then show the average modindex of all signals for each qualifying status.
alternatives.sql:
WITH avg_modindex AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg,
    MAX(CASE WHEN modindex > (SELECT overall_avg FROM avg_modindex) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_above_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, status_avg
  FROM status_with_stats
  WHERE has_above_avg = 1
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT 
  sa.rfistat,
  sa.status_avg as avg_modindex,
  sa.status_avg - (SELECT overall_avg FROM avg_modindex) as above_overall_avg,
  sa.status_avg - qm.mean_of_qualifying as diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM status_averages sa
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
ORDER BY sa.status_avg DESC
